title: Acme Subscription-Type Hotfix
status_detail: implemented-local-validated; awaiting staging burn-in + prod deploy
context: ROOT CAUSE: Worker (worker-sync prod) never emits subscription_type on dealer CREATE/UPDATE; api-core dealer.subscription_type defaults to 'premium' on insert; DealerService::updateDealer has no cascade onto inventory; no audit log. Acme dealers with source Premium='No' are stored 'premium' and all inventory rows mirror the wrong value with no self-correction path. RULE: for dealer.from IN ('mainfeed','acme','crm'), dealer.subscription_type strictly governs every inventory.subscription_type row; source of truth for Acme = CSV 'Premium' column ('Yes'->premium else basic). FIX: worker always-emits subscription_type derived from Premium on CREATE+UPDATE; API validates (nullable|string|in:basic,premium) + writes gated on from allowlist + logs; cascade onto inventory is async (PRIMARY = end-of-batch hook in ProcessFeedQueueJob, SAFETY NET = daily sweeper), idempotent mass-UPDATE, ShouldBeUnique uniqueFor=900s, kill-switch FEED_SUBSCRIPTION_CASCADE_ENABLED. DESIGN ROUTE: synthesis of Route C (worker emit) + async cascade; watchdog/self-reschedule DROPPED in plan stage for end-of-batch hook + sweeper.
